entries.en: Rescuers? Thank God!
See? I told you somebody would come to investigate that signal.
My name is Doctor Ross. Chief ExoGeni researcher at this facility.
We've been trapped in this room for days. We're almost out of food and water. You got here just in time!
How do you know about the Thorian?
Our secret's out, then. No point in my lying. You already know the worst.
The creepers here were created using altered samples from the specimens on Feros. We discovered a way to turn them into docile, obedient servants.
Everything was going fine until a few days ago. Then all the creepers suddenly went berserk. Only a handful of us made it back into the safety of this room.
Maybe there was still some kind of link between the creepers and the Thorian back on Feros.
The Thorian was unlike any other life-form we've ever studied. I can't explain how, but maybe when it died, it somehow set off the creepers here.
This is a closed communications base. ExoGeni was worried about someone on the project selling secrets to a rival firm, or reporting our work to the authorities.
We have no direct communication with the outside. Only the emergency beacon. It sends a general distress signal to the ExoGeni site on Feros.
They're supposed to send a team to respond inside of 24 hours, but it sounds like they had problems of their own.
I doubt it. Too many creepers out there. They never stood a chance. We're the only ones left.
We knew there were risks. But I thought we'd taken all the necessary precautions. I didn't mean for this to happen!
Look... I know what we did here was wrong. I'll admit that. But it's over now. There's no sense reporting this to the authorities, right?
Be reasonable. I didn't mean for this to happen. Besides, how does it help anyone if I end up in jail?
Normally ExoGeni would have my back, but it sounds like they're going to have their hands full cleaning up the mess on Feros.
But I've got money. A nice little emergency fund I set up. It's yours if you let us go.
That's not going to happen.
You made the smart choice, Commander.
Open fire! Open fire!
I need to know what's going on. Why is this place crawling with Thorian creepers?
Not so fast. First you're going to tell me why this place is overrun with Thorian creepers.
I know what ExoGeni was up to. I saw what they let the Thorian do to those colonists. So I destroyed it.
Any idea why they turned on you?
I've heard all I need to.
Why didn't you send a clear message asking for help? All we had was that signal from the emergency beacon.
Any chance some of the other people at the base might still be alive?
What did you expect? You couldn't really believe those things were safe.
You were in charge of this project. The safety of the staff was your responsibility. They trusted you, and you betrayed that trust!
Maybe we could work something out.
Too many people died here. Their blood is on your hands.
The victims here deserve justice. I have to take you in.
Deal. Get the hell out of here.
This isn't about money. It's about justice. Blood for blood.
You're okay now.
What happened here?
I need answers.
I've seen it.
I killed it.
I was on Feros.
Berserk creepers
Generic Distress Signal
Other Survivors
Serves you right.
No more questions.
People lost their lives here!
What are you offering?
Somebody has to pay.
I can't do that.
Okay.
I should kill you right now!
